verdict.rationale: First-party support docs and release notes say 1Password can create, save and manage passkeys and sign in with them on websites and apps from the browser extension. Watchtower also flags logins that could be upgraded to a passkey, so this goes clearly beyond TOTP storage. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of passkey sign-in, and explicit documentation of passkey sign-in to native mobile/desktop apps outside the browser.
